description: This file defines the Smarty_Internal_Compile_Child class, which is an internal plugin responsible for compiling the {child} tag in Smarty templates. It handles attribute parsing, validation, and code generation for the 'child' tag within Smarty's templating system.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Child
classes.description: Represents the internal compilation logic for the {child} tag in Smarty templates, extending Smarty_Internal_CompileBase, and responsible for generating PHP code to implement the tag's behavior.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the {child} Smarty tag into PHP code, handling attribute validation, scope checks, and code output for template inheritance.
